description: An anatomical containment relationship directed from a part structure to a whole structure. It includes structural part-of relationships from Uberon and the human brain containment hierarchy from HOMBA. Source support on an edge can also reflect a subtype relationship between the same structures; the edge label does not guarantee that every listed source asserts part-of rather than is-a.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources supporting the relationship between these anatomical structures. Source values include "uberon" and "HOMBA".

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of creation or an update to the edge.

source_contributions.scope: Relationships between non-obsolete terms in the Uberon basic multi-species anatomy ontology, with both endpoint structures represented as Anatomy nodes.
source_contributions.description: Uberon describes part-of relationships as structural containment; an anatomical term may be part of several wholes. Uberon support on a PARTOF_ApA edge may also express an is-a relationship between the same terms.

source_contributions.scope: Human brain structures in the Allen Institute Human Brain Atlas ontology, including regions, areas, layers and nuclei.
source_contributions.description: HOMBA parent-child links represent anatomical containment, from the child structure to its parent. Some grouping structures read more naturally as classes, but the source does not distinguish them. Relationships use the anatomical granularity shared with Uberon where the structures coincide; distinct HOMBA regions can therefore share an anatomical representation. Links whose endpoints represent the same anatomical structure are absent.
